verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a readiness report or score for how prepared a repository is for autonomous agents. Related features, such as generating setup commands from the repository structure or analyzing sandbox setup logs for errors, are environment-setup aids rather than a readiness assessment, so they earn no credit. The axis fairly applies to an agent platform like Codegen, which is why this is 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run a readiness report that evaluates how ready my repository is for autonomous agents
